request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The summary shows, for each period, the change of its due-total from the period before it by
start date (this period's due-total minus the previous one's, two decimals, a minus sign when lower);
the earliest period shows nothing.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The summary now has a change column for each period, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

Each period's change is its due-total minus the due-total of the period just before it by start date. It has two decimals and a minus sign when lower, and it's empty for the earliest period. It's shown as `summary-period-<name>-change`. Periods are put in start-date order before comparing, so a period that was created later but starts earlier is still counted as "previous". The test checks this case by adding P2 before P1.

The change is front-end only, in two files:
- **`src/main/frontend/features/summary/summary.slot.tsx`**: adds a "Change" column to the periods table. Each period's due-total is now worked out once and reused for both columns.
- **`src/main/frontend/features/rates/ratesQuery.ts`**: adds a small `difference(sum, previous)` helper. It uses the same whole-cents arithmetic as the other totals, so no rounding is introduced.

No stored data, server or audit records were needed, since the change can be worked out from figures the screen already loads.
